project_type: Python HTTP server with vanilla JS frontend - PV installation simulator
test_framework: unittest (Python stdlib), test files in backend/tests/test_*.py
verification_instructions: Run unittest discover command above. All tests must pass (currently 274).
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Python stdlib project
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network. Python stdlib only - no external packages.
contribution_requirements: All comments and variable names in Polish. Push to feature/restore-all-lost-work branch.
key_patterns: Dataclasses for models. Functions organized by service module. Energy in Wh internally, kWh for display. RCE prices via pobierz_cene_rce(miesiac, godzina) returns PLN/kWh brutto. Profiles normalized to sum=1.0 for hourly distribution. 8760 hourly values per year.
directory_structure: backend/services/ - business logic; backend/models/ - dataclasses; backend/api/handlers.py - HTTP endpoints; backend/tests/ - unittest files; backend/data/ - JSON data files; frontend/pages/ - HTML pages
